subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept `openai/codex-action` revision 52fe01ec for the three agent workflows that can handle OpenAI API credentials?
rationale: This is a trust-boundary decision about an externally maintained action’s runtime, sandbox, and credential-handling behavior; mechanical version-bump review cannot establish that policy choice.

options.title: Audit and prove before merge
options.body: Review the exact 1.11 action source/changelog and attach redacted successful runs from the affected credentialed workflows before merging.

options.title: Accept the revision risk
options.body: Explicitly accept the updated external action revision without additional source audit or workflow evidence.

options.title: Split out Codex Action updates
options.body: Merge the non-Codex action bumps separately and hold the three Codex Action references for focused security review.

recommendation.title: Audit and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Review the exact 1.11 action source/changelog and attach redacted successful runs from the affected credentialed workflows before merging.
